title: Running time of buffered sequential composition
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $f,g$ be functions from Boolean words to Boolean words, and let $T_1,T_2$ be natural-valued functions on word lengths. Suppose $M_1$ computes $f$ in time $T_1$, $M_2$ computes $g$ in time $T_2$, and $T_2$ is monotone. Then the buffered sequential composition of $M_1$ and $M_2$ computes $g \circ f$ in time $n \mapsto 2\bigl(T_1(n)+T_2(T_1(n))+1\bigr)$.

$f$ and $g$ map Boolean words to Boolean words
